cells.gaps: The World Bank's series gives 31.4 per cent for 2024; the agency official's 25 per cent of March 2025 is stated as 'as low as' and names no year.
cells.note: The latest figure, 25 per cent of rural people given by a rural electrification agency official in March 2025, is below the 27 per cent line, so stage 1. Under message 138 a figure from any source counts, not only the World Bank series.
